FIELD NOTES

Small hero. Big axe.

Explore the garden as our flower-hooded adventurer. Collect all 8 sunstones, smash 12 targets, then return to the glowing shrine. Follow the north path beyond the shrine to enter the treasure cave. Inside, walk back through the blue-lit south passage to leave.

WASD / arrows — move
Shift — run · Space — throw
Click / Space — throw straight ahead
Q / E or right-drag — rotate camera
R — raise view · F — lower view
Sound — background music and effects
Scroll — zoom · Esc — close help

Move to face a direction. She keeps that heading when you stop, and axes fly straight ahead. On touch screens, use the joystick and Throw.
